domain.excluded: 100 mA/cm2 (bubble artifacts), <=10 mA/cm2 (surface oxidation dominance), per upstream Readme recommendation
domain.samples: metadata.csv rows (all status_of_run == success) that have both 'CP 50 mA cm-2 dc_data.csv' and 'CP 20 mA cm-2 dc_data.csv' files
domain.target_channel: last-third mean of 'Corrected Voltage (V)' per CP file (iR-corrected working-electrode potential, factor 0.9, per SDL1 experiment.py correct_for_ohmic_resistance and its .tail(len/3).mean() extraction)
domain.overpotential_definition: overpotential_v = corrected_potential_v - 1.23 (OER equilibrium offset on the upstream-reported potential scale); reference-scale assumption recorded as a limitation

condition_definition: unique tuple of (chemicals_to_mix nominal composition dict, deposition_current [A], electrodeposition_time [s], total_volume [ml], electrodeposition_temperature_setpoint [C]); every replicate sample and every time point of a condition stays on one side of the split
split_rule: held_out iff int(sha256(canonical_json(condition_key)).hexdigest(), 16) % 4 == 0, computed over the sorted canonical condition tuple; approximately 25% of conditions; deterministic, no reassignment permitted

model.form: eta(x, j) = a + b*log10(j_A_cm2) + sum_m w_m * x_m, ordinary least squares on fit-split condition-replicate rows
inputs: nominal precursor mole fractions x_m for Ni, Fe, Cr, Mn, Co, Zn, Cu normalized over metal entries
complexing agent flags NH4OH, NaCi as supplied in chemicals_to_mix
OER current density j in A/cm2 (log10 term)
model.selection_procedure: single pre-declared form, no hyperparameters, no alternative models compared; all-zero input columns dropped; no refitting after held-out inspection
model.uncertainty: declared sigma = standard deviation of fit-split residuals; reported per prediction as declared uncertainty

held_out_overpotential_mae_v.rule: MAE over all held-out condition-replicate rows at both current densities must be <= 0.05 V

uncertainty_coverage_2sigma.rule: fraction of held-out rows with |error| <= 2*sigma must be >= 0.8

candidate_order_spearman.rule: Spearman rank correlation between predicted and observed held-out condition-mean overpotential, pooled over both current densities after per-j mean-centering, must be >= 0.7

missing_data_behavior.rule: model refuses inputs outside the admitted domain (composition entries outside the seven metals + two complexing agents, j outside [0.02, 0.05] A/cm2) with a typed out-of-envelope reason; verified by behavior test, not a fitted metric

calibrated_twin_grant_shape: if and only if every gate passes: calibrated-twin evidence is admitted solely for channel overpotential_v (and its corrected-potential basis) from operation measure-oer, for nominal precursor compositions within the convex set of fit compositions over the seven metals with NH4OH/NaCi levels seen in fit data, at OER current densities in [0.02, 0.05] A/cm2, electrolyte/temperature as in the dataset; everything else remains simulator evidence
failure_rule: if any gate fails, calibrated-twin admission is denied, the failed report is preserved verbatim, thresholds are not revisited
